summary: Hertford County Public Schools emphasizes the importance of E-Rate for maintaining affordable and reliable broadband connectivity in their rural district, which has experienced significant changes in technology needs due to the COVID-19 pandemic. They urge the Commission to preserve E-Rate as a long-term investment to support educational capacity and infrastructure upgrades. The comment argues against limiting or sunsetting E-Rate, emphasizing its importance as an infrastructure program for reliable connectivity and educational outcomes. The text discusses the importance of E-Rate in supporting educational technology and infrastructure in schools. It highlights how E-Rate has allowed the district to focus on its broader educational mission while still providing necessary technology infrastructure. The text also emphasizes the need for E-Rate to facilitate long-term infrastructure planning and ensure reliable, secure, and appropriately scaled network infrastructure to support educational uses, rather than dictating how schools ed The school district urges the FCC to maintain meaningful support for both Category 1 and Category 2 services and to recognize ongoing network capacity, reliability, resiliency, and security as continuing needs.
